brazil.title: Flag of Brazil

colors.note: Represents the forests and natural resources
Represents the sky over Rio de Janeiro
Contains the national motto 'Ordem e Progresso'

desc: - A green field with a yellow diamond containing a blue sphere with a white band inscribed 'Ordem e Progresso'
- Adopted four days after the Proclamation of the Republic in 1889
trivia:
- Each of the 27 stars represents a specific Brazilian state or federal district
- The arrangement matches the night sky over Rio de Janeiro at 8:30 AM on 15 November 1889 (the date of the republic)
- The yellow represents mining wealth; green represents the forests; blue represents the sky and sea
